newsitem.title: USA: Cheshire, Conn. seeks $38 mln school budget--paper.
newsitem.headline: Cheshire, Conn. seeks $38 mln school budget--paper.

text.p: The superintendent of schools for Cheshire, Conn., has proposed raising the 1997-98 budget by six percent to $37.7 million, mainly to pay for another 10 positions to cope with more students, the Harford Courant said in its Friday edition.
The official, Ralph Wallace, projected enrollment would rise by 100 to 4,600 during the next school year.
After it is adopted by the school board, the new budget msut be reviewed by the town manager and town council, the paper said.
